title: host identity and host-persistent state are host facilities: navigator, location, localStorage, sessionStorage
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, 'Host Globals': host functionality MUST be represented by typed capabilities. `navigator.userAgent` read the host's identity with zero diagnostics, no capability, and no layer; `localStorage` is host-persistent state, which is the same class of authority as a filesystem. reference/capabilities.mdx, 'Platform Services', is where these belong.
